CHANNEL_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE.en-US: Notification and channel service is not ready. Please try again later; if the problem persists, restart the local service.
CHANNEL_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE.zh-CN: 通知与渠道服务暂未就绪，请稍后重试；若持续失败，请重启本地服务。

CHANNEL_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT.en-US: Notification and channel service timed out. Please try again later; if the problem persists, restart the local service.
CHANNEL_GATEWAY_TIMEOUT.zh-CN: 通知与渠道服务响应超时，请稍后重试；若持续失败，请重启本地服务。
